{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me dirigía a un país{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} en el que la
gente se pirra{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} por una comida
superpicante llamada "kimchi".{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Se dice que comen tanto kimchi{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
que tienen frigoríficos exclusivos
solo para guardarlo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Eso tengo que verlo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿Será verdad

en todas las casas? No sé yo...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ese país es también famoso por
el arte marcial del taekwondo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Salto y patada!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Salto y patada!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Toma!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Otra patada! ¡Kiaaa!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}¡Que me emociono!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es que yo
practiqué taekwondo durante
cierta época.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Qué tiempos!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¿Que no me crees? {{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Patadaaa!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Veamos... ¿y qué más?
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}¡Ah, sí! {{TAG:0003:002A:}}¡Sus grupos de música
pop pegan muy fuerte en Asia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bueno, bueno,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿ya sabes de qué
país se trata?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je voguais vers un pays où les gens
ne mangent quasiment que du
kimchi super épicé ! 
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}On raconte même qu'il n'est pas
rare d'avoir plusieurs
réfrigérateurs chez soi...
... juste pour stocker le kimchi ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Enfin, il paraît{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Moi, je crois que ce
que je vois !

un sport qu'ils appellent taekwondo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}D'après ce que j'ai compris, ça

{{TAG:0007:000B:}}WOUH, tout en sautant en l'air ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Alors, alors ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu peux me dire quel
est ce pays dont je parle ?

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Manche haben einen eigenen Kühl-

{{TAG:0007:000B:}}TRITT!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0007:000B:}}TRITT! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Hijaaa!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ich habe das vor einigen Jahren auch

Taekwondo...
.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Glaubst du mir etwa nicht?
{{TAG:0007:000B:}}TRITT!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}So... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Was noch?

heiße Popmusik-Szene!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Gut!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Reicht das? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Weißt du,

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}This place is an island!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yup,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} an
island in the middle of the ocean,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
which is where I'd put an island!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's famous for giant heads carved
out of rocks.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ever seen 'em?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
Some are buried, though.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hear they're called moai, and there
are something like 887 of 'em{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} just
facing out to sea.
Maybe they're watching for me?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Wow!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Thanks for lookin' out for
me, rocks,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001F:}}but I gotta{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ROLL!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Just kidding!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}I don't think I've
ever met these bunch of heads
before!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}I'm sure I'd remember them.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Though, then again,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} I DO seem to
have a habit of forgetting things
when I get tossed to sea{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Doesn't matter.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I feel like I've got
to pay my respects to them.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}It's the
sailor in me, I suppose.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}That's why I have to get to that
island at any cost!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}So do you know the place I'm
talking about?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}El sitio al que iba es una isla.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Sí, una bonita isla en medio del
mar. ¿Dónde iba a estar si no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Es famosa por unas cabezas
de piedra medio enterradas
que hay en ella,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿sabes?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Creo que hay unas 887 cabezas
o así, ¡son un montón!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Y las
llaman "moái" o algo así.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Ajá!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mi motivo para ir a la isla
era pedir que me hagan una cabeza
de piedra con mi cara.{{TAG:0003:001F:}} Mola, ¿eh?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}¡Es broma, es broma!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
No creo que las hagan por encargo.
¡Y, si así fuera, tardarían mucho!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}De todas formas,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} siento que debo
verlas al natural por una vez. {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Debe
empujarme mi espíritu aventurero.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Ayúdame a encontrar esa isla!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Sabes de qué lugar te hablo?

en este país:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} sus deliciosos
chocolates. ¡Mmmmm!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Y también hay muchos restaurantes
exquisitos!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Es el paraíso para un
gourmet como yo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Pero tengo que moderarme.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Soy delicado de estómago y no
puedo comer cualquier cosa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En fin, eso es todo lo que puedo
contarte.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿Se te ocurre de qué
lugar puede tratarse?
FR:
Je naviguais vers un pays qui est
célèbre pour une statue appelée le
Manneken-Pis.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Elle représente un petit garçon en
train de faire quelque chose qui ne
se fait pas en public !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce pays est également réputé pour
son chocolat, sans doute le meilleur
du monde !
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Faut dire qu'on mange bien, là-bas...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Il y a des restaurants à tous les
coins de rue !
Parfait pour un gastronome tel que
moi ! {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ou pas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'ai l'estomac très
fragile, je dois faire attention.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bref, tu vois de quel pays je veux
parler ?
IT:
Il paese in cui ero diretto è
famoso per una statua chiamata
"Manneken Pis"!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Fossi in lui, mi vergognerei a fare
quello che fa! Così, davanti a tutti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Poverino, avrà la vescica debole...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ma non dimentichiamoci la vera
specialità locale: il cioccolato
di questo paese è delizioso!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}E poi è pieno di ottimi ristoranti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Adoro le cozze con le patatine
che puoi trovare dappertutto!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Magari dovrei andarci piano!
Sono un volatile dallo stomaco
delicato, io{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Comunque sia... Hai capito?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Lo sai dov'ero diretto?
DE:
In dem Land, in das ich wollte,
gibt es eine Statue namens
Manneken Pis!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ganz schön mutig der Kleine,
so vor aller Welt...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber noch viel wichtiger:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} die
Schokolade!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hmmmmm!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ich hoffe, ich übertreibe es
nicht wieder und verderbe
mir den Magen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wie dem auch sei... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Weißt du,
von welchem Land ich rede?
TRANSLATION:
Gideceğim ülke Manneken Pis
denen heykelle epey ünlü. O{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
çocuğun yaptığı şeyi insanların
önünde yapmaya ben{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} utanırdım;
ufaklık bayağı{{TAG:0003:0001:}} cesur! Ama asıl
önemli şeyi{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}} unutma: çikolatası
nefis! Bir sürü{{TAG:0003:0005:}} restoranı da
var. Ben{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} yemek düşkünü olduğum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
için hepsine uğramak isterim!
Belki{{TAG:0003:0009:}} hepsine{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} değil... Midem
hassas{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}, çok dolmadan bırakmaya
çalışırım{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} İşte böyle bir yer.
Bir{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} çağrışım yaptı mı?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}When you think of the country
I was headed to, you instantly think
of flamenco dancing!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Those nimble steps!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} The music!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}It's a very passionate dance!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}And the food! {{TAG:0003:0005:}}I hear it's the only
place to go when you've got a
hunger for paella or tapas.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}There's also a very famous building
that's still under construction after
more than a hundred years!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}It's been worked on by people for
generations, but{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} they still aren't
done with it! Why not?!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}I was heading there partly to help
out with construction, since my
help is greatly needed.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}And I think that's about all I can
remember{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Does this place sound
familiar to you at all?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Solo el nombre del país al que
me dirigía{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ya suena a ritmo de
guitarra y zapateo. ¡Ole!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Esa música tan alegre!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}¡Esos bailes llenos de fuerza!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}A mí me encanta su comida.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡La paella! ¡Y las tapas variadas
que comparten entre amigos!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Hay bellos monumentos en muchas
de sus ciudades.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Otras destacan
por su moderna arquitectura.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¡Aunque hay una famosa basílica
en construcción{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} que continúa
inacabada después de cien años!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}No lo entiendo... Tanta gente
trabajando durante tanto tiempo...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}¿Necesitarán voluntarios?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eso es todo lo que recuerdo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿Reconoces qué lugar puede ser
ese, con tanto arte y salero?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Le pays dans lequel je me rendais
est connu pour ses danses et sa
musique endiablées. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Olé !
Ah ça, il faut dire que là-bas, les
gens {{TAG:0003:002C:}}ont le rythme dans la peau.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ils ne sont pas en reste en termes
de gastronomie ! La paella, les
tapas à partager... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}MIAM !
Dans les villes se mêlent d'anciens
monuments et des chefs-d'œuvre
d'architecture moderne.
Il existe même un édifice qui est en
construction depuis plus de cent
ans !
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Comment est-ce possible, avec tous
ces ouvriers qui travaillent dessus ?{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Je vais leur proposer mon aide...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Il y a encore tellement de choses à
dire sur ce pays... {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Tu vois duquel je
veux parler ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Se pensi al luogo in cui ero diretto,
la prima cosa che ti viene in mente
è il flamenco!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Che trasporto!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Che musica!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:002C:}}È una danza piena di passione
e di sentimento!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}In questo paese puoi anche
imbatterti in qualche torero
sprezzante del pericolo.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ne hanno di coraggio, eh?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Pensa che in una sua città si tiene
perfino una corsa in cui la gente
viene inseguita dai tori per strada!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}E poi in questa nazione c'è anche
un celebre edificio in costruzione
da più di 100 anni!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ci hanno lavorato generazioni
di persone,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma non hanno ancora
finito! Chissà come mai?!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ad ogni modo, stavo andando
proprio lì a dare una mano!
Sono un abile costruttore, io!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non ricordo altro{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu hai capito
dove ero diretto? Dammi una mano,
ho un vuoto di memoria!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Wenn man an das Land denkt, in das
ich wollte, denkt man sofort an
feurige Gitarrenrhythmen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Die Musik reißt einen mit!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Der Tanz
ist voller Leidenschaft!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002C:}}Olé!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Aber am meisten liebe ich das
Essen. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Paella!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und Tapas, die
man mit seinen Freunden teilt!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}In den Städten mischen sich alte
Monumente mit moderner
Architektur!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Es gibt eine berühmte Kirche, die
nach 100 Jahren Bau immer noch
nicht vollendet ist!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Wie kann das sein, wenn so viele
Leute so lang daran arbeiten!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ob sie meine Hilfe brauchen?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tja, an mehr kann ich mich leider
nicht erinnern{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kommt dir das
irgendwie bekannt vor?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Gideceğim ülke denince insanın
aklına hemen flamenko geliyor!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} O
kıvrak{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} adımlar,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} müzik{{TAG:0003:002C:}}... Tutku
dolu bir{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}} dans!{{TAG:0003:0005:}} Yemekleri de
cabası: paella ya da tapas
istediğinde gidilecek{{TAG:0003:0000:}} yer orası.
Bir de yüz yılı aşkın süredir
hâlâ tamamlanamamış çok{{TAG:0003:000D:}} ünlü bir
yapı var! Nesillerdir
yapıyorlar{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}, hâlâ bitmedi.
Neden?!{{TAG:0003:0021:}} Ben de inşaata yardım
etmeye gidiyordum; belli ki bana
çok{{TAG:0003:0001:}} ihtiyaçları var.
Hatırladığım bu{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kadar{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}. Burası
sana tanıdık geldi mi?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}In that country,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} there's a city some
people call the art capital of the
world!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Like,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} art EVERYWHERE!
It has the Eiffel Tower,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} the Arc de
Triomphe,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} the Louvre{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Art's just
comin' out their noses!
Plus the fashion is very appealing.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}My outfit was even once included in
a fashion show when last I visited!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Uh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I don't know which one it was
without double checking.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Comment allez-vous?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm begging
you!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Please tell me the name of
this country!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} My style demands it!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Una ciudad del país al que iba{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} es
considerada por muchos la capital
mundial del arte.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Tiene la Torre Eiffel,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} el Arco
de Triunfo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} el Louvre{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡El arte
rebosa por todos sus rincones!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}También su moda destaca.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0021:}}De
hecho, el traje que llevo puesto se
presentó en un importante desfile.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Eeehh...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} No me preguntes en cuál,
tendría que consultarlo...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¿Qu'est-ce que c'est?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿No se te
ocurre?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿Qué país puede ser?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Il existe une ville dans ce pays dont
on dit qu'elle est la capitale de l'art.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}La Tour Eiffel,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} le Louvre, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}l'Arc de
Triomphe{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je pourrais te citer
mille exemples de chefs-d'œuvre !
Ce pays est aussi le royaume de la
mode ! {{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'ai déjà assisté à plusieurs
défilés, d'ailleurs.
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Un jour,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je suis même monté sur le
podium pour éblouir la foule avec
mon sens du style !
On dit aussi que la langue de ce
pays {{TAG:0003:0004:}}est celle de l'amour... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Alors, tu
as deviné de quel endroit je parle ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}In questo paese c'è una città
che molti considerano la capitale
mondiale dell'arte! La Ville Lumière!
Ci trovi la Torre Eiffel,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} l'Arco di
Trionfo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} il Louvre{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ci sono così
tante cose da vedere!
Per non parlare della moda...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Pensa che l'ultima volta che ci sono
stato mi hanno chiesto di fare
il modello in una sfilata di moda!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0007:}} Ehm,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} che c'è? Non mi credi?
Guarda che sono un bel gabbiano!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Parbleu, c'est terrible!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ti scongiuro!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Dimmi il nome di questo paese!
Ho voglia di sfilare di nuovo lì!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Die Hauptstadt des Landes,
wo ich hinwollte, ist eine der
berühmtesten Städte der Welt!
Dort stehen der Eiffelturm,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} der
Triumphbogen, Notre-Dame{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ein Monument neben dem anderen!
Und das berühmteste Museum der
Welt ist auch da: {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}der Louvre!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Auch für Mode ist der Ort berühmt.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Mein Outfit wurde dort auch einmal
bei einer Modenschau präsentiert!
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Die Leute waren nicht gerade
begeistert, aber was soll's.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Kannst du mir helfen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}s'il te plaît?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Wie heißt denn dieses Land
noch mal?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}O ülkede{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} dünyanın sanat başkenti
denilen bir şehir var. Her{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} yerde{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
sanat! Eyfel Kulesi, Zafer{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Takı,
Louvre...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sanat resmen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
burunlarından taşıyor! Modası da
çok çekici. Son{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} gidişimde
kıyafetim bir moda gösterisine
bile çıkmıştı!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}} Hangisiydi{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}},
kontrol etmeden
hatırlayamıyorum.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Comment
allez-vous{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}? Yalvarıyorum{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}, bu
ülkenin adını söyle!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Tarzım buna bağlı!

EN:
All right,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} so the country I wanted to
visit is very long and sort of shaped
like a boot!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Just like I wear!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Whoa!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Where'd my boots go?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}You know what else is long?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Pasta!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Their pasta is so good,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
it'll make you tell off your mama!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}But,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hey,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} be careful,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} because if your
mom is anything like mine,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} she's a
nice lady and she deserves respect.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}This place is also famous for a
place called the Eternal City.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Awwww{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} What's the name?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} I feel
like the answer is on the tip of my
beak!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Oh, Fortuna!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I could use you!
ES:
El país al que quería llegar es
estrecho y alargado, como una
bota.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Igual que estas que llevo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Eh? ¡¿Pero dónde han ido a
parar mis queridas botas?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
En fin...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}También recuerdo algo que todos
comen allí:{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} ¡pasta! ¡Cocinan la
pasta incluso mejor que tu madre!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Bueno, bueno...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sin menospreciar
a tu madre, grumetill{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ella se
merece todo mi respeto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¿Y de la capital, qué puedo
decir?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es conocida como
"la ciudad eterna".{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Mamma mia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Lo tengo en la
punta de la lengua!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ¡Dime qué
país puede ser, grumetill{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
FR:
Le pays que je voulais visiter a la
forme d'une botte, comme celles
que je porte !
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh ! Mais, où sont mes bottes ?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Y'a autre chose qui me botterait
bien, tiens : {{TAG:0003:0005:}}une bonne platée de
pâtes ! Mamma mia, j'adore ça !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Mamma mia... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Voilà une expression
qu'ils utilisent souvent dans ce
pays ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ça veut dire « ma maman ».
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quoi d'autre... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ah oui, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}la capitale de
ce pays est surnommée la Ville
Éternelle.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aaah ! Comment s'appelle donc ce
pays ?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Je l'ai sur le bout du bec !
IT:
Allora, il paese che volevo visitare
ha la forma di un lungo stivale!
Proprio come quelli che indosso io!
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ehi! Ma che fine hanno fatto
i miei stivali?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Beh, pazienza! {{TAG:0003:0016:}}A proposito di forme
strane...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}È un posto famoso
per la sua pasta di tutte le forme...
... penne, ditali, orecchiette,
conchiglie... Mi raccomando però!
Occhio a non confonderti!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Le farfalle al sugo, per esempio,
mica sono insetti!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ah! E poi questo paese è conosciuto
anche perché ospita la Città eterna!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Uffa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ma che paese è?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ce l'ho
sulla punta della lingua, ma proprio
non mi viene! Tu lo sai?
DE:
Kennst du das Land, wo die Zitronen
blühen?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Es ist länglich. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Von oben
sieht es wie ein Stiefel aus!
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Apropos länglich!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Dort gibt es ganz
lange Nudeln!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und kurze! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Und
gefüllte!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und überbackene!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Die Hauptstadt des Landes nennt
man die „ewige Stadt“.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh Mann{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wie hieß denn das Land
noch mal?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Es liegt mir auf dem
Schnabel!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kannst du mir helfen?

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce pays est connu pour ses ninjas{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
et ses samouraïs ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Quels nobles
guerriers ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}YAAAH ! 
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Enfin,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000C:}}tout ça c'est de l'histoire
ancienne{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mais moi, {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Gulliver{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0003:0006:}} je vais inventer
une nouvelle caste de marins
guerriers : les ninjas de la mer !
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Enfin, bref{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu vois de quel pays je
veux parler ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Allora, in questo paese c'erano
ninja e samurai!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Vedessi come
usavano le spade!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Solo che...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Oggi purtroppo sono scomparsi
dalla vita di tutti i giorni{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
Appartengono al passato.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Che tristezza! Mi sento come
un gabbiano ingabbiato se ci penso!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ecco perché io, Gulliver,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}darò vita
a una nuova stirpe di ninja marinai!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ci chiameremo i "marininja"!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mmmh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Beh, ad ogni modo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Hai capito in che paese ero diretto?
Aiutami a ricordare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In dem Land, auf das ich Kurs
genommen hatte, gibt es Ninja!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Und Samurai!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Beziehungsweise gab.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000C:}}Ninja und
Samurai gehören heute wohl nicht
mehr zum Straßenbild{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ach ja, und das Land wird seit
fünfzig Jahren immer wieder von
einer riesigen Echse verwüstet!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Moment... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Waren das Dokumenta-
tionen oder Spielfilme, die ich im
Fernsehen gesehen hab?
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ich komme aber einfach nicht
darauf, wie dieses Land heißt{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Weißt du es vielleicht?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The country I was headed to is very
green!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Everywhere you look,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yup,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
you'll see green.
It's to the point they sometimes call
this place the Emerald Isle.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}The symbol of this country is the
shamrock,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} which is a type of clover.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Also,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} the music from this country
has really impacted music from all
over,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} especially indie rock!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I feel like I'm so close to unlocking
my memories,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but I'm stumped!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
Like it's at the end of a rainbow!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}You gotta help me!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Please tell me
the name of this country!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mi destino era un país en el que
todo es verde.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mires hacia donde
mires, el verdor lo cubre todo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Tanto es así, que también es
conocido como "la isla esmeralda".{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}El símbolo del país es un trébol.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Y su música pop ha triunfado
por todo el mundo{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} en los
últimos años.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Ooouh, yeah!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡No puedo creer que no consiga
recordarlo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Ayúdame!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Dime el
nombre del país! ¿No lo sabes?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le pays que je voulais visiter est
vert de partout.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est une chance
que j'adore cette couleur !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Dis-toi qu'ils en viennent même à
l'appeler l'île d'Émeraude.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Cette île a pour symbole le trèfle,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}de préférence à quatre feuilles !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est aussi une terre de musiciens,
dont les mélodies ont grandement
influencé le rock indépendant !
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Raah, impossible de me souvenir du
nom de ce pays...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu veux bien
m'aider ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il paese in cui ero diretto è
verdissimo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ci sono prati e pascoli
a vista d'occhio.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
È così verde che alcuni lo chiamano
"Isola Smeralda"!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Il suo simbolo nazionale?
Credo sia il trifoglio! Vuoi sapere
se ho qualche altro indizio?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La musica celtica! E poi ricordo
uno gnomo che vive in fondo
all'arcobaleno!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Dicono che ci sia una pentola
piena d'oro lì! Devo trovarlaaa!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ti prego, aiutami!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dimmi come
si chiama questo paese!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das Land, wo ich hinwollte, ist
ganz grün!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es wird sogar die
„grüne Insel“ genannt.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Das Nationalsymbol ist ein
dreiblättriges Kleeblatt.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001C:}}Ich hatte vor, mir dort einen
Kobold zu fangen, um an
seinen Goldtopf zu kommen!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ich habe das Gefühl, ich bin ganz
nah dran.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Aber der Name des
Landes fällt mir einfach nicht ein!
Du musst mir helfen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wo sollte
mein Schiff mich hinbringen?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The country I was headed to has
huge waterfalls called Niagara Falls!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Also,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} in the night sky,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you can see
the aurora borealis!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's beautiful
and leaves such an impact on you!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm pretty sure I was headed there
to see its beautiful wilderness,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
maple leaves and all{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} My beloved maple syrup!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Please tell me you've heard
of this country!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} You've gotta!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En el país al que viajaba{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} están las 
espectaculares cataratas del río
Niágara. ¡Una pasada!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Por la noche, en el cielo, se puede
ver la aurora boreal.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Es preciosa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Nunca verás nada igual!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}No es raro que me viera atraído
por la naturaleza salvaje de ese
lugar...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡y por su sirope de arce!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Dime que sabes de qué país te
hablo! ¡Debes conocerlo! ¿No?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}On trouve dans ce pays une
merveille de la nature : les
chutes du Niagara.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Et parfois, le soir, on peut y voir
des aurores boréales !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Elles ne
laissent personne indifférent...
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Les gens là-bas font un drôle de
sirop à partir d'un arbre qui
s'appelle l'érable{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aaah !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Le légendaire sirop d'érable !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Avec des pancakes, c'est un régal
pour les papilles... {{TAG:0003:0002:}}et les mamilles !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Dis-moi que tu vois de quel pays je
parle ! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}S'il te plaît !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il paese in cui ero diretto è famoso
per le sue imponenti e maestose
Cascate del Niagara!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Nelle lunghe notti invernali, poi, qui
puoi ammirare l'aurora boreale!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Che spettacolo mozzafiato!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}E poi è un posto ricco di boschi
con interi tappeti di foglie di acero!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Sigh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Il mio amato sciroppo d'acero!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Che voglia di mangiarmi un piattone
di frittelle con lo sciroppo d'acero!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ti prego, aiutami!
Dimmi tu dov'ero diretto!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In dem Land, das ich besuchen
wollte, gibt es viele Bäume!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Und Bären!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Am Nachthimmel ist manchmal das
Nordlicht zu sehen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wer das einmal
gesehen hat, vergisst es nie wieder!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Auf eines hab ich mich ganz
besonders gefreut,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} was war
das noch mal{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}?
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ach ja!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ahornsirup!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Auf der Flagge
ist auch ein Ahornblatt!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bitte, das
muss doch reichen... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wo ist das?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I was headed to a country that's so
full of life it's hard to comprehend!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}There are live mariachi bands that
perform such fun, lively music it
makes you dance,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} even in the heat!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Sure,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} we assume there's a lot of
desert,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} but it's just like any other
warm, dry place of the world{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}And,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} oh,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} the FOOD! {{TAG:0003:000D:}}It can give a
seagull a stomachache if he's not
careful! {{TAG:0003:0029:}}And I rarely am!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}The trouble is I never know how
to eat in moderation, {{TAG:0003:0024:}}so I always
overeat!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}That's no bueno!
Still, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}I may be a gull of the sea,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
but that country makes me long
for a life near the Sierra Madre!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Help me out, mi amigo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} If you know
the name of this country,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} you've
just gotta tell me!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Me dirigía a uno de los países
más cálidos y alegres del mundo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Hay unos grupos musicales, los
mariachis, que te hacen bailar con
su música{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} por cansado que estés.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hay una gran extensión de desierto,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} 
pero es normal en un lugar tan seco
y caluroso{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Oh, y qué rica está la comida!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aunque las gaviotas solemos
tener el estómago delicado...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Bueno, en realidad...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0024:}}yo siempre
acabo tragando más de la cuenta.
¡Ay, ay, ayyy!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Ayúdame! ¿Qué país crees
que es? ¡Dímelo, ándaleeee!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}J'étais en route vers un pays où
les gens font la fête toute l'année !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Des musiciens qu'on appelle
mariachis font danser les gens avec
leur musique rythmée !
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}On dit qu'il y fait très chaud et
qu'une partie de ce pays est
recouverte par le désert{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Et comment ne pas parler de leur
nourriture ! {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Quel dommage que j'aie
l'estomac aussi fragile...
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Le problème, c'est que je ne sais
pas manger avec modération. {{TAG:0003:0024:}}C'est
pas bueno pour la santé !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Et que dire de la Sierra Madre...
Même moi qui suis pourtant un
marin, j'en suis fan ! {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Aide-moi, mi amigo !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Si tu connais
le nom de ce pays, dis-le-moi !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ero diretto in un paese che sprizza
entusiasmo e gioia di vivere da
tutti i pori!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Con tutte quelle bande di "mariachi"
che suonano senza sosta anche
nelle giornate più calde e afose!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Alcuni dei suoi abitanti indossano
enormi cappelli che si chiamano
"sombreros"{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}E il cibo... Che delizia! Mangerei
chili e chili di quei manicaretti!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Non riesco proprio a dire di no!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}E così finisce sempre che faccio
indigestione! No es nada bueno!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}E poi, anche se sono un gabbiano,{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
non disdegnerei affatto abitare
sulle vette della Sierra Madre!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}È una catena montuosa
di questo paese!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ayúdame, amigo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Se hai capito
di che paese sto parlando, dimmelo!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich wollte in ein Land voller Leben,
Heiterkeit und Musik!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Die Mariachi-Gruppen spielen so
mitreißende Rhythmen, dass man
trotz der Hitze mittanzen will!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Was gibt's noch{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wüsten, Kakteen...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ach, und das Essen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Tacos,
Enchiladas, Guacamole...
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Um sich da nicht zu überfressen,
muss man sich ganz schön zurück-
halten!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0029:}}Bei mir klappt das nie...
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Du musst mir helfen, Amigo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wenn
du weißt, wie das Land heißt, dann
sag es mir!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Gideceğim ülke o kadar canlı ki
insanın başı dönüyor!{{TAG:0000:0004:}} Mariachi
grupları öyle hareketli müzik
çalıyor ki sıcakta bile dans{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
ettiriyor. Çölü{{TAG:0003:000B:}} çok{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} sanılır ama
dünyanın diğer{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} sıcak ve kuru
yerlerinden pek farklı değil.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Bir{{TAG:0003:0004:}} de{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} YEMEKLER!{{TAG:0003:000D:}} Dikkat etmezse
martının midesini altüst eder;{{TAG:0003:0029:}}
ben de pek{{TAG:0003:0028:}} dikkat etmem! Ölçülü
yemeyi beceremediğim{{TAG:0003:0024:}} için hep
fazla{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} kaçırırım. No bueno!{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Ben
deniz martısıyım{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ama bu ülke
bana Sierra Madre yakınlarında
yaşama{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} isteği veriyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yardım et
mi amigo! Ülkenin{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} adını
biliyorsan söyle!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The country I was headed to is filled
with castles that look just like they
popped right out of a fairy tale!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Someday I plan on finding a sweet
princess of my own and living with
her in one of those castles.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Plus this place is famous for
sausage!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Like, REALLY famous!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I don't care much for sausage
myself,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} what with me eating
mostly grubs and fish.
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}But grub sausage?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}That'd be the
absolute greatest thing ever!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}But it's not all fun and sausages!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Science runs RAMPANT through
all of its history!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Heard of the theory of relativity?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Yeah, I{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}don't understand it myself,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}but the guy who DOES understand
it was born in this country!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}He was kinda smart.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Sorta like an
Einstein, you know?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Real egghead.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Alrighty then,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} do you know where
I was headed?!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}You've gotta!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}El país en cuestión está lleno de
castillos{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} que parecen sacados de
un cuento de hadas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Mi sueño es encontrar algún día
a una bella princesa{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} y llevarla a
vivir a uno de esos castillos.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}¿Y qué decir de las salchichas?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
A los habitantes de ese país{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
les encantan las salchichas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Vaya!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Me ha entrado hambre
al hablar de comida{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Pero no creas que lo único que
hay en ese país son castillos y
salchichas.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Hay mucho más!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Allí también nacieron notables
científicos, y la gente es muy
ordenada y trabajadora.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A ver, ¿sabes entonces qué país
es el que te estoy describiendo?
¡Ojalá lo sepas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce pays est célèbre pour ses
innombrables châteaux tout droit
sortis de contes de fées !
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Un jour, je rencontrerai une belle
princesse et nous vivrons ensemble
dans un de ces châteaux.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Ce pays est aussi réputé pour ses
saucisses.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Les meilleures du monde !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Avec de la moutarde, c'est divin.
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Oh, pardon !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Rien que de penser à
ces délicieuses saucisses, ça me fait
saliver{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ce pays a également vu naître de
très grands scientifiques ! {{TAG:0003:0017:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}As-tu entendu parler de la théorie
de la relativité ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}C'est un truc qui permet de calculer
des machins, je crois... {{TAG:0003:0020:}}Bref, le type
qui l'a inventée est né dans ce pays.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}C'était un génie, un Einstein comme
on dit ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Pas une tête de piaf,
comme moi...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Alors, tu vois de quel pays je veux
parler ? Dis-moi que oui !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il paese in cui ero diretto è pieno
zeppo di castelli che sembrano
usciti da un libro di fiabe!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Un giorno conoscerò la mia
principessa azzurra e mi trasferirò
in uno di questi castelli con lei!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Questa nazione è famosa anche
per i suoi würstel!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ma che dico
famosa, famosissima!
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}A me quei salsicciotti non piacciono
moltissimo.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Sai, a me piace il pesce!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}E se facessero dei würstel di pesce?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Slurp! Sarebbe fantastico!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Comunque, {{TAG:0003:0006:}}oltre a castelli e würstel
c'è di più! {{TAG:0003:0016:}}La storia di questo
paese è intrisa di scienza!
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Mai sentito parlare della
"teoria della relatività"?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Mah, io non ci capisco un'acca,
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}ma il tizio che la formulò
nacque proprio in questo paese!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Era uno intelligente. Tipo Einstein!
Anzi, forse era proprio Einstein!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Allora? Hai capito dov'ero diretto?
Aiutami a ricordare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In dem Land, wo ich hinwill, werden
viele Autos gebaut.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Autos wurden
sogar dort erfunden!
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Früher war es auch als das „Land
der Dichter und Denker“ bekannt.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ach ja!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und klassische Musik!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es hat
die berühmtesten Komponisten der
Welt hervorgebracht.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich habe mal in einem Symphonie-
orchester gespielt, musst du wissen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Hey, auch Triangel ist anspruchsvoll!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Also, weißt du, in welches Land ich
wollte?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du bist meine einzige
Hoffnung!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Gideceğim ülke masaldan çıkmış
gibi görünen kalelerle dolu! Bir
gün{{TAG:0003:0021:}} tatlı bir prenses bulup
onunla o kalelerden birinde
yaşayacağım{{TAG:0003:002B:}}. Bir de sosisle
ünlü;{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} hem de ÇOK!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} Ben genelde
kurtçuk ve{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} balık yediğim için
sosis pek{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}} aramam. Ama{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} kurtçuk
sosisi? İşte o{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} şaheser olurdu!
Her şey{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}} eğlence ve sosis değil;
bilim{{TAG:0003:0017:}} tarihi de dopdolu.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}
Görelilik{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kuramını duydun{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}} mu?
Ben de anlamıyorum ama anlayan
adam{{TAG:0003:001B:}} bu ülkede{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} doğmuş. Biraz
zekiydi{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}... Hani{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}} Einstein{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} gibi!
Peki nereye{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}} gidiyordum?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The country I was headed to is
really famous for its tulips!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Being near all those colorful flowers
gives an almost magical feeling!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Though some of that magic may
have been blown in by the gigantic
windmills,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} which are also awesome!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Wait.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Windmills don't really work
like that, do they...?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Point is,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} I'd never forget the sight
of the windmills in the tulip fields!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0029:}}Too bad I can't remember the name
of the country!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Just my luck.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Does that description sound like
anywhere you can think of?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}El país del que te hablo{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} es
famoso por sus tulipanes.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Esas flores de colores tan variados{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
tienen un aspecto casi mágico.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Y los molinos! ¡Son preciosos!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Qué impresionantes cuando
los ves con sus aspas girando!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}En mi memoria se ha quedado
grabada esa imagen:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} molinos
entre campos de tulipanes...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0029:}}Sin embargo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} el nombre del país
lo he olvidado por completo...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¿Conoces algún lugar que coincida
con lo que te he contado? ¡Piensa
un poco, grumetill{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le pays en question est célèbre
pour ses tulipes.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Toutes ces couleurs vives partout,
ça crée une atmosphère magique !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dommage que tous ces moulins
viennent gâcher le paysage !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Avec leurs immenses ailes, ils me
font toujours dévier de ma
trajectoire quand je passe à côté !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Enfin, je suppose que ça confère
une certaine beauté esthétique à
l'ensemble.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0029:}}Pff, comment ai-je pu oublier le
nom de ce pays... {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tu peux m'aider,
peut-être ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il paese che volevo visitare
è famoso per i suoi tulipani!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Tutti quei campi di fiori tra
i mulini a vento sono un richiamo
per migliaia di farfalle variopinte!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Spero solo che quelle povere
farfalline non finiscano schiacciate
dalle pale dei mulini!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Sarebbe una vera tragedia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}In questo paese puoi comprare
zoccoli di legno chic da sfoggiare
nell'orto! Magari ne avessi un paio...
{{TAG:0003:0029:}}Non riesco a ricordarmi come
si chiama questo posto!
Ce l'ho sulla punta della lingua...
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tu hai capito di quale paese
si tratta?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das Land, in das ich wollte, ist
berühmt für seine Tulpen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Die gibt es in allen Farben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Oh, wie romantisch!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Die großen Windmühlen sind auch
sehr beeindruckend! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Was wird damit
eigentlich gemahlen? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Der Gouda?
{{TAG:0003:0029:}}Wenn ich mich jetzt noch an den
Namen des Landes erinnern könnte!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Hast du nicht irgendeine Ahnung?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Gideceğim ülke laleleriyle çok
ünlü! O rengârenk{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}} çiçeklerin
arasında insan kendini büyülü
hissediyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}. Belki büyünün bir
kısmını dev yel değirmenleri{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
üflüyordur. Gerçi{{TAG:0003:000B:}} değirmenler{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
öyle çalışmıyor, değil mi?
Neyse,{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}} lale{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} tarlalarının
arasındaki yel değirmenlerini
asla{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0029:}} unutmam. Ülkenin adını
unutmuş olmam da{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} tam benim{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}
şansım! Tarif sana bir yeri
hatırlattı mı?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}This country is famous for movies
from a place called Hollywood!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I'd like to be in a movie myself
someday.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} I'd be the star of a bunch
of fancy high-seas adventures!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}But, wait!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} In most boat movies, the
boat sinks.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} It{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}it doesn't have to be
that way, though,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} right?!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Oh no!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} If I was tossed into the sea,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
it'd go from a work of fiction to
being my autobiography!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I'm gonna have to have a chat with
the film directors in that country!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Now then,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} what's that country
called,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} and how can I get there?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Iba al país por antonomasia de las
series de televisión y las películas.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿Has oído hablar de Hollywood?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Aquí donde me ves,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} quizá yo llegue
algún día a ser una estrella de la
gran pantalla.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} ¿Por qué no?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Un intrépido marino que vive
mil aventuras en alta mar!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Pero...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} espero que la película
no termine con un naufragio...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡No!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} No quiero acabar en el agua.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Hablaré con el director para que
filme un final feliz.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Pero volviendo al tema:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿sabes
de qué país estoy hablando?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce pays est réputé pour un endroit
où l'on fait des films et qui s'appelle
Hollywood.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'aimerais bien jouer dans un film...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Je serais le marin héroïque qui
protège les océans des pirates !
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh{{TAG:0007:0000:07000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:07000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:07000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:07000000}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Peut-être que je ferais la
rencontre d'une belle sirène !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}À moins que le réalisateur ne décide
de faire couler mon bateau... Hmm...
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Parfois la fiction rejoint la réalité !
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}J'en toucherai un mot aux
scénaristes !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bon, revenons à nos moutons... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tu 
peux me dire quel est ce pays dont
je parle ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Questo paese è famoso per i suoi
film girati in una città chiamata
Hollywood!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sai, mi piacerebbe tanto essere
il protagonista di una pellicola
d'azione girata in mare!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Aspetta un attimo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Molti dei film
ambientati tra le acque dell'oceano
finiscono con un naufragio.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Oh, no!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Se finissi in mare,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} più
che un'opera di finzione, il film
sembrerebbe un'autobiografia!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Devo andare a scambiare due
paroline con i registi di 'sti film!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Peccato che non mi ricordi
di che paese si tratti!
Tu hai qualche idea?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aus diesem Land kommen fast alle
großen Filme!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Besonders die mit
Explosionen und Verfolgungsjagden!
Und auch die mit Cowboys und
Indianern!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Kein Wunder, denn Cow-
boys und Indianer sind auch von da...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich wäre sicher auch der geborene
Schauspieler.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Am liebsten in einem
Film mit einem Schiff!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Aber Moment!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} In Filmen mit
Schiffen sinkt das Schiff oft
am Ende...
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Reicht es denn nicht, dass ich im
echten Leben schon dauernd über
Bord gehe?!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich werde mir die Regisseure in
diesem Land mal vorknöpfen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Sobald mir der Name des Landes
wieder eingefallen ist, können die
sich warm anziehen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu ülke Hollywood denen yerde
çekilen filmleriyle{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} ünlü! Ben de
bir gün film yıldızı{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} olmak
isterim. Şatafatlı açık deniz
maceralarının{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} başrolü olurum!
Ama dur... Tekne{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} filmlerinde
tekneler çoğu zaman{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} batıyor.{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}
Mecbur{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} değil, değil mi?! Denize{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
düşersem kurgu film bir anda
otobiyografime{{TAG:0003:0006:}} dönüşür! O
ülkedeki yönetmenlerle bunu
konuşmam gerekecek{{TAG:0000:0004:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Peki ülkenin
adı ne ve{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} oraya nasıl giderim?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}The country I was headed to is a
real animal's paradise!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Animals as
far as you can see on the savannah!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}There are giraffes,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} elephants,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} lions,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
and of course,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}GULLIVER!{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} At least
there will be when I show up.
{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}I want to get to that country,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
spread my wings,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} and float free
on the warm breeze.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}You ever heard of this place?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
Can ya help me out?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Iba de camino a un país{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}} que
está considerado el paraíso
de los animales salvajes.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Jirafas,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} elefantes,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} leones
viviendo en la amplia sabana...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Hasta hay un...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡GULLIVER!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bueno, lo habrá cuando yo llegue
allí, es lo que quiero decir, ja, ja.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Me encantaría poder estirar mis
alas en ese lugar{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}} y dejarme llevar
por el viento sobre esas tierras...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}¿Te suena familiar el sitio?
¡Ayúdame, por favor! Dime
su nombre si lo sabes.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Il paese in cui ero diretto è
stracolmo di animali che se ne
vanno a zonzo per la savana!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ci sono giraffe,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} elefanti,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} leoni{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
e, ovviamente,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}GULLIVER!{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
Il re di tutti gli animali!
{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Non vedo l'ora di arrivare in quel
posto, spiegare le ali e spiccare
il volo verso il sole al tramonto.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Hai capito di che paese sto
parlando? Puoi darmi una mano tu?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}In dem Land, in das ich wollte,
streifen viele verschiedene Tiere
durch die Savanne!
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Giraffen, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Elefanten,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Löwen...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Wusstest du eigentlich, dass Löwen
mit Möwen verwandt sind?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hört
man ja schon am Namen!{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}
{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ach, wie schön muss es sein, dort
die Flügel auszubreiten und auf
der warmen Brise zu schweben!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Hast du von diesem Land schon
mal gehört?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Weißt du, wie es heißt?

EN:
The country I was headed to has a
huge desert.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}And when I say huge,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
I mean {{TAG:0003:001F:}}HUGE!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0022:}}Sand everywhere!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}It's famous for tall, triangle-shaped
buildings called pyramids.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}How they
built them, I'll never know.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tricky thing is,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} those pyramids are
actually the graves of the ancient
pharaohs.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0011:}}Mummy curses, I tell ya!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Someday I'd like to marry a nice
princess and rule the desert{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Wait!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}I can't live in a place without
constant water!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} The Nile's nice,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} but
I need the open sea!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Anyway,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} do you know where I was
headed?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}I could really use your help!
ES:
Mi destino era un país con un
desierto inmenso. {{TAG:0003:001F:}}¡Arena, arena{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0022:}}y más arena!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}El monumento más famoso son
unas pirámides antiquísimas{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}que
no se sabe cómo se construyeron.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Lo curioso es que las pirámides
son tumbas de antiguos faraones.
{{TAG:0003:0011:}}¡Deben de estar llenas de momias!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Mi sueño sería casarme algún día
con una hermosa princesa y que
gobernásemos juntos el desierto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}¡Un momento!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Pero en un lugar
sin agua corriente yo no podría
vivir...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Qué incomodidad...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}El Nilo no está mal, pero no puede
compararse con el mar abierto.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}A lo que íbamos: ¿sabes cómo
se llama el lugar que te estoy
describiendo?
FR:
On trouve un immense désert dans
ce pays. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}IMMENSE, je te dis !
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}}Du sable partout !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Je pourrais aussi te parler des
pyramides, ces édifices pointus qui
ont traversé les âges...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}... et dans lesquels reposent les
pharaons et sans doute quelques
momies.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Aah, toutes ces légendes me font
rêver{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Peut-être rencontrerai-je
une belle princesse du désert ?
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Attends !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Comment je vais survivre
sans eau moi ? Il y a bien le Nil,
mais ça ne vaut pas l'océan...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Bref, j'y réfléchirai plus tard.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu
peux m'aider à retrouver le nom de
ce pays ?
IT:
Il paese in cui ero diretto ha
un enorme deserto. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}E quando dico
"enorme", {{TAG:0003:001F:}}intendo "ENOOOORME"!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}È famoso per i suoi alti edifici
dalle facce triangolari chiamati
piramidi.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Pensa che nessuno sa come
sono state costruite!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In realtà sono le tombe dei
faraoni! Mummia mia... {{TAG:0003:0029:}}Ehm...
Volevo dire "mamma mia"!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Un giorno mi piacerebbe sposare
una bella principessa e diventare
il sovrano del deserto{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Aspetta un attimo!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Non potrei mai
vivere in un posto così arido!
Il Nilo è bello, ma il mare aperto...
... è la mia vita! {{TAG:0003:0000:}}Comunque sia...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Hai capito dov'ero diretto?
Aiutami a ricordare!
DE:
In dem Land, in das ich wollte, gibt
es eine riesige Wüste. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wirklich
{{TAG:0003:001F:}}ENORM!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0022:}}Sand, wohin man schaut!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Es ist berühmt für seine dreieckigen
Gebäude. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Die sind auch riesig.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Keine
Ahnung, wie die gebaut wurden!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Diese Gebäude sind in Wahrheit die
Grabmäler von Pharaonen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0011:}}Hüte
dich vor dem Fluch der Mumien!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Vielleicht werde ich dort eine
Prinzessin heiraten und über die
Wüste herrschen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Aber Moment!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Wie soll ich ohne
Wasser überleben? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Ach ja, der Nil.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Der ist natürlich ganz nett...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Aber egal... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Weißt du, wie
das Land heißt?
TRANSLATION:
Gideceğim ülkede kocaman bir çöl
var.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} KOCAMAN! Her yer{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} kum!{{TAG:0003:001F:}}
Piramit{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0022:}} denen uzun{{TAG:0003:0000:}}, üçgen
biçimli yapılarıyla ünlü. Nasıl
yaptılar,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}} aklım almıyor. İşin
ürkütücü yanı{{TAG:0003:0001:}}, piramitlerin{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} eski
firavunların mezarı olması.
Mumya laneti{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0011:}} derim ben! Bir gün
güzel{{TAG:0003:0004:}} bir prensesle evlenip çöle
hükmetmek isterdim{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}} Dur{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}!{{TAG:0003:000D:}}
Sürekli su olmadan yaşayamam!
Nil{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} güzel ama bana{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} açık deniz
lazım. Nereye{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} gidiyordum,
biliyor musun?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}} Yardımına
ihtiyacım var!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The country I was going to is huge!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
More people live there than pretty
much anywhere else in the world!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}The country also has a long and
complicated history with ancient
dynasties and wushu and such{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} man,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} it's amazing how much
stuff this country has invented.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
{{TAG:0003:001F:}}Paper! Gunpowder! Compasses!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}It's like there's no way to stop the
amazing progress in this country's

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Iba camino de un país enorme,
gigante,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} el que más habitantes
tiene del mundo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Con sus numerosas dinastías y sus

muy larga{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. ¡Como la Gran Muralla!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y es admirable la cantidad de cosas

{{TAG:0003:001F:}}el papel, la pólvora, la brújula...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}No es extraño que hayan sufrido

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me dirigía a un país con cientos

mitología que surgió en él, con

{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Poseidón era el dios del mar,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} así
que seguro que él y yo haríamos
buenas migas, {{TAG:0003:001B:}}je, je, je.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}También hay diosas en esa

¡Por Zeus y el Olimpo!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le pays où je veux aller est riche en

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}L'histoire des civilisations me

llamados llamas y alpacas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Se parecen a los camellos,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero
son de color blanco y su pelo
tiene aspecto esponjoso.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Cómo me gustaría acurrucarme
junto a alguna!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Se debe de estar
tan calentito con ese pelaje...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡Oh!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Pe...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero no quiero ir allí por

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Le pays dans lequel je me rendais
est connu pour ses géoglyphes, des
immenses dessins à même le sol !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ces dessins sont extrêmement
mystérieux...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Qui les a dessinés ? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Comment s'y
sont-ils pris ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Et surtout, que
signifient-ils ?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Moi qui m'interroge beaucoup sur
le monde, je dois dire que ça
m'intrigue...
{{TAG:0000:0003:0500}}(Et hop,{{TAG:0000:0003:0500}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0500}} je passe pour un intello !){{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ah, ça me revient !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Il y a aussi
d'étranges animaux dans ce pays,
des alpagas je crois bien.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Les alpagas ressemblent à des
chameaux, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}sauf que ce ne sont pas
des chameaux, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}ce sont des alpagas.
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Tu vois de quoi je parle ? Ils sont
tout blancs, avec une fourrure
douce comme de la laine !
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ooh ça me donne envie de frotter
mon bec contre leur doux pelage
pour l'éternité !
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Euh...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Enfin... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Le but de ma visite
est avant tout scientifique, bien
sûr. {{TAG:0003:0021:}}Les géoglyphes m'attendent !
Plus une minute à perdre ! Je
m'envole vers...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}euh... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Comment
s'appelle ce pays déjà ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Il paese in cui ero diretto è famoso
per dei grandi disegni realizzati
sul terreno chiamati "geoglifi".
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si tratta di figure circondate
da un'aura di mistero!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Che significano? Chi le ha tracciate?
Come sono state tracciate?
E, soprattutto, perché?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}I suddetti quesiti non fanno altro
che acuire la mia fervida curiosità
intellettuale!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0500}}Ammappete, come parlo forbito!{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Ehm,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} e poi hanno dei simpatici
animaletti chiamati alpaca!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sembrano dei cammelli,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma sono
bianchi e hanno un manto soffice.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Come?{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Ne hai visto uno rosa?!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Impossibile!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ti ho detto che
sono bianchi! {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Rosa? Ma per piacere!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Mi viene voglia di strapazzarli
di coccole! Sono{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} soffici,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} soffici,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
soffici! Che morbidoni!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}L'ho già detto che sono soffici,
soffici, soffici?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Ehm...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001A:}}N-n-{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}naturalmente ero diretto
lì soprattutto per studiare i geoglifi!
Il mio è un interesse scientifico!
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Il fatto che sia pieno di alpaca è...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}
ehm... semplicemente secondario!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Uffa, dai! Aiutami a ricordare
il nome di questo paese!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Riesige Zeichnungen auf dem Erd-
boden, die nur vom Flugzeug aus
sichtbar sind:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} die Nazca-Linien!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dafür ist das Land berühmt, in das
ich wollte.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Diese Linien sind von
Geheimnissen umwoben.
Wer hat sie gemalt? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Auf welche
Weise?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wofür?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sind sie eine
Nachricht an Außerirdische?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Auf intellektueller Ebene muss ich
solche parawissenschaftlichen
Spekulationen natürlich ablehnen!

{{TAG:0000:0003:0500}}({{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0500}}Ich höre mich sooo schlau an!){{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Und,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} äh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} es gibt da diese tollen
Tiere namens Alpakas!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Die sehen wie kleine Kamele

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Was?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ob Alpakas alle rosa oder

{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Man möchte sie umarmen und
durchs Fell streicheln und knuddeln,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
knuddeln,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} knuddeln,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} knuddeln!
Und dann noch eine Runde knuddeln!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Aber, äh...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ich will natürlich dorthin,
um das Rätsel der Nazca-Linien zu
lösen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Nicht wegen der Alpakas!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ach, wem mache ich denn etwas

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}It's a resort!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's a tropical island!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
It's{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Well, if I could just remember,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
I wouldn't need your help right now.
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}On the beach next to the clear, blue
sea,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} people gyrate their hips to
dance the hula while in grass skirts!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}I want to stand on the beach and
hula in a grass skirt too!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}The greeting on the island is
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}ALOHA!{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It's a very happy and energetic
greeting, don't you think?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Perfect for Gullivers!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}So then,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}can you tell me the name

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}La isla tropical a la que me dirigía
es un popular destino de vacaciones.
¡Un verdadero paraíso!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Sol y playas con agua de color azul
intenso.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} En la orilla, los nativos
bailan una danza llamada "hula".{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Tengo que comprarme una camisa
de flores y bailarla yo también!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Y para saludar se dice...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}¡aloha!{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es una palabra extraña,
pero suena bien, ¿verdad?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}En fin, lo que me importa es
si sabes de qué lugar se trata.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¿Puedes ayudarme o no?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est une île tropicale !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Une station
balnéaire super branchée ! Ça
s'appelle... {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Oh non, je sais plus !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Sur la plage de sable fin, des gens
portent des chemises à fleurs et
dansent le hula.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Tu crois que ça m'irait bien, la

{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}ALOHA !{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ça donne la pêche, tu trouves pas ?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Je sens que ce pays est parfait pour
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Gulliver{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Tu vois duquel je veux parler, dis ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}È un luogo da sogno!
Un'isola tropicale! {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Se solo potessi
ricordarmi come si chiama...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}La gente là balla l'hula sulla spiaggia
con addosso un gonnellino di paglia!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Magari potessi ondeggiare le anche
in riva al mare anch'io!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ah, un'altra cosa! Il saluto locale è
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}ALOHA!{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Un saluto incisivo, allegro e vivace,
non trovi anche tu?
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Perfetto per uno come me!
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Allora? Sai dirmi dove ero diretto?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Es ist eine tropische Insel!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ein
Traumziel für viele Urlauber!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}An weißen Stränden schwingen die
Leute in Grasröcken die Hüften
zum Hula!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ich will auch mitschwingen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Auf der Insel begrüßt man sich mit
{{TAG:0003:0020:}}{{TAG:0000:0002:9600}}ALOHA!{{TAG:0000:0002:6400}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ein fröhliches Wort, nicht wahr?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
